Class ServerMessageVisitorImpl

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.visitors.ServerMessageVisitorImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerMessageVisitor
public class ServerMessageVisitorImpl extends Object implements ServerMessageVisitor
Concrete implementation of ServerMessageVisitor.

Handles all messages received from the server by updating the VirtualModel and notifying the UserInterface. Order-sensitive UI updates (e.g. events before game ending) are serialized through a single-threaded executor to prevent race conditions.

    • visit

      public void visit(QuitAckMessage ackMessage)
      Visits a QuitAckMessage.

      Two distinct situations trigger this message:

      • Self-initiated quit — ClientSocket.quit() already reset the local state synchronously before this ack arrives; in that case Client.isInGame() is already false and the UI must not be notified twice.
      • Server-initiated quit — e.g. the post-game "back to menu" acknowledgement, where the client has not reset its state yet and this is the only notification it will receive.
      The visitor is always reinstalled, since it is cheap and keeps the socket ready for the next message regardless of which case applies.
      Specified by:
      visit in interface ServerMessageVisitor
      Parameters:
      ackMessage - the quit acknowledgement message containing the quit reason
